3a64e0b83bdc4f5c.description: About the Role Azure is seeking a Storekeeper to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing daily warehouse and inventory activities to ensure the accurate receipt, storage, handling, and issuance of materials and goods. The Storekeeper will support efficient warehouse operations through proper stock control, accurate documentation, and compliance with established procedures, working under the supervision of the Warehouse Manager. Key Responsibilities Receive incoming materials and goods, verifying quantities and specifications against purchase orders and delivery documents. Inspect received items for damage, defects, or shortages and report discrepancies to the Warehouse Manager. Organize and store materials in designated locations, ensuring proper labeling, identification, and accessibility. Issue and dispatch materials against approved requests, maintaining accurate supporting documentation. Update inventory records and ensure all stock movements are accurately recorded in the ERP system. Monitor stock balances and report low-stock levels and replenishment requirements to the Warehouse Manager. Conduct periodic physical stock counts and assist in investigating inventory discrepancies. Ensure proper handling, storage, and preservation of materials to prevent damage, loss, or deterioration. Identify damaged, expired, obsolete, or slow-moving stock and report findings to the Warehouse Manager. Maintain accurate records of received, issued, returned, and transferred materials. Ensure the warehouse is clean, organized, secure, and compliant with health and safety standards. Coordinate with relevant departments regarding material requests, deliveries, and returns. Prepare inventory and stock movement reports as required. Perform other related duties as assigned by the Warehouse Manager. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant storekeeping or warehouse management role. A strong understanding of inventory control principles and warehouse operations is essential for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring on-site presence to manage daily warehouse and inventory activities effectively.

3ac02bdbd9bc8130.description: About the Role SSCL is seeking a Plumber Pipe Fitter Technician to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the installation, maintenance, and repair of plumbing and pipe systems, ensuring optimal flow, pressure, and functionality. The technician will be responsible for system inspections, issue detection, and corrective actions, all while adhering to safety regulations and company standards. Key Responsibilities Install, maintain, and repair plumbing and pipe systems to ensure proper flow, pressure, and functionality. Inspect piping systems, joints, and fixtures to detect leaks, blockages, or other operational issues. Repair or replace defective pipes, valves, and fittings to restore system integrity and performance. Ensure all installation and repair work complies with relevant building codes, safety regulations, and company standards. Maintain accurate documentation of maintenance, repair, and inspection activities for reporting and recordkeeping purposes. Collaborate with other technicians, engineers, and contractors on complex plumbing and piping projects or system upgrades. Manage the ordering, tracking, and storage of plumbing materials, tools, and spare parts to support maintenance operations. Respond promptly to emergency repair requests, performing corrective actions to minimize downtime and system disruption. Train and guide junior staff in plumbing and pipe fitting procedures, safety standards, and maintenance best practices. Participate in ongoing technical and safety training programs to stay current with evolving industry methods and technologies. Ensure alignment of individual and team efforts with organizational strategic goals, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Perform any additional duties or tasks assigned by the direct supervisor to support departmental and organizational objectives. Qualifications and Requirements Diploma in Plumbing or a related field. 2-5 years of experience in plumbing or pipe fitting. Certification in Plumbing or Pipe Fitting (if applicable). Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a team to maintain and repair critical infrastructure, requiring adherence to strict safety and quality standards. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3affea04cbf64edd.description: About the Role Technical Xperts Group (TXG) is seeking a BIM Engineer Structural to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience in structural BIM modeling and documentation. The role focuses on developing and maintaining structural BIM models and coordinating with various project teams. Role Overview The BIM Engineer Structural will be responsible for creating and managing 3D structural BIM models using Revit. This involves practical experience in developing structural models and ensuring effective coordination with architectural and MEP teams to maintain model accuracy and project compliance. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain 3D structural BIM models utilizing Revit software. Model various structural elements including foundations, columns, beams, slabs, and walls. Prepare comprehensive structural layouts, sections, details, and drawings. Update models based on engineering drawings and design revisions. Coordinate structural models effectively with architectural and MEP disciplines. Identify and resolve clashes and discrepancies within the models. Ensure model accuracy and adherence to specific project requirements. Collaborate with engineering teams to meet established project deadlines. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in structural BIM modeling and documentation. Demonstrated understanding of structural systems, construction drawings, and detailing. Ability to accurately interpret structural drawings and specifications. Proficiency in developing structural models and coordinating with architectural and MEP teams. Required Skills Strong communication and coordination skills. Proficiency in Revit for BIM modeling. Additional Information Immediate joiners are preferred for this position. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

3a16e6f1b0e639a5.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Hotel Cleanliness Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh and Ad Dir'iyah. This full-time position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on maintaining high standards of cleanliness and guest satisfaction within the hotel environment. Key Responsibilities Inspect guest rooms, public areas, and facilities such as the pool after cleaning to ensure quality standards are met. Manage daily room status reports, verify room discrepancies, prioritize cleaning schedules, and update the status of departing guest rooms. Support Housekeeping management in daily operational activities and coordinate efforts between Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry departments. Document and resolve issues related to discrepant rooms with the Front Desk, and communicate changes in room assignments. Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating employees. Ensure adherence to all company and safety and security policies and procedures, reporting any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries. Maintain a professional appearance, ensure confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome guests according to company standards, anticipate service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with appreciation. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing up to 55 pounds without assistance, and over 55 pounds with assistance. Capability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for extended periods across an entire work shift. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Qualifications and Skills 0-1 years of experience in a related field. Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with guests and colleagues. Proficiency in using computers and/or point-of-sale systems to enter and locate work-related information. Capability to read and visually verify information in various formats. Commitment to developing and maintaining positive working relationships with others. About The Luxury Collection The Luxury Collection Hotels & Resorts, part of Marriott International, offers authentic experiences across over 120 properties in more than 35 countries. With a heritage spanning over 100 years, the brand focuses on delivering genuine, personalized, and anticipatory hospitality. Each hotel and resort reflects its locale's cultural charms and treasures, providing a unique guest experience. This role is an opportunity to contribute to a portfolio of brands committed to fostering professional growth and a sense of belonging within a global team. Application Information We invite qualified candidates to apply for this position to contribute to the high standards of Marriott International. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3a819fd4f484862c.description: About the Role NATCO Middle East is seeking an experienced Terminal Manager to join its logistics team. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves overseeing daily terminal operations to ensure efficiency and compliance. Role Overview The Terminal Manager will be responsible for optimizing terminal and yard space, managing cargo movement, and supervising a team of drivers. A key aspect of this role involves developing and maintaining strong relationships with third-party transport vendors to support operational demands. Key Responsibilities Manage terminal and yard space to optimize storage capacity, cargo movement, and handling efficiency. Supervise, schedule, and guide drivers to ensure safe and on-time deliveries. Recruit, onboard, and retain qualified drivers to meet operational demand. Negotiate with third-party transport vendors to secure competitive rates and favorable service terms. Develop and manage a reliable third-party transportation vendor network, maintaining strong long-term relationships. Oversee daily terminal operations in compliance with HSE standards and Saudi regulations. Coordinate with customs authorities, clients, and internal teams to ensure smooth cargo handling. Required Qualifications and Experience Proven experience of 5-10 years in terminal, warehouse, or transport management in Saudi Arabia or the GCC. Demonstrated long-standing presence in the Saudi logistics market, with an established network of transporters and vendors. Strong negotiation and vendor management skills. Strong leadership and team management abilities. Sound knowledge of local transportation and logistics operations. Work Environment This role is a full-time position within NATCO Middle East's logistics team, operating in Jeddah, Makkah. The Terminal Manager will work within a dynamic environment, coordinating with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure efficient logistics operations. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

3a1bde50c02a0d36.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب وطني للخدمات العامة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، متابعة الإيرادات، وتدقيق الحسابات المصرفية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمحاسبين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المخصصة. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. معرفة جيدة بأساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإعداد وتوثيق المستندات المالية. دقة في التعامل مع الأرقام والبيانات المالية. القدرة على تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق متخصص في مكتب وطني للخدمات العامة، حيث تتاح له الفرصة لتطبيق وتطوير مهاراته في بيئة عمل داعمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

3a44557b5ad2b7f3.job_title: IT Procurement & Vendor Management Analyst - Saudi Arabia
3a44557b5ad2b7f3.description: The IT Procurement & Vendor Management Analyst supports Digital Services (DS) by managing and coordinating the end-to-end procurement lifecycle for IT services, applications, technology assets, and related operational requirements, from procurement planning and vendor coordination through delivery verification, invoice review, and payment follow-up. The role contributes to renewal strategies, commercial evaluation, vendor performance, and asset lifecycle planning to achieve value for money, financial accuracy, compliance, and service continuity. It identifies opportunities to optimize spending and strengthen procurement and invoicing processes, working closely with DS service managers, Finance, Procurement, and suppliers. Scope of Work DS Procurement Planning & Execution Coordinate DS procurement activities across DS services, software applications, subscriptions, maintenance, and technology assets. Work with service owners to consolidate requirements, plan procurement timelines, and prepare complete, compliant procurement requests and supporting documentation. Track purchase requests, purchase orders, contract milestones, approvals, and delivery commitments; proactively resolve bottlenecks and escalate risks. Support projects with procurement and financial documentation, ensuring contracts, approvals, and milestones align with DS budgets. Renewal Strategy & Asset Lifecycle Coordination Maintain a forward-looking register of service, software, and support contract renewals, including expiry dates, costs, usage. Support renewal and sourcing strategies by assessing demand, licensing needs, alternatives, consolidation opportunities, and service continuity risks. Coordinate with asset owners on procurement requirements arising from technology refresh, replacement cycles, warranties, and asset management plans. Value for Money & Vendor Management Analyze procurement spend, quotations, pricing structures, and contract terms to identify cost efficiencies and opportunities for better value. Coordinate vendor engagement, monitor delivery and contractual performance, and follow up on commercial or service issues with responsible teams. Support competitive sourcing, vendor evaluations, and negotiations in coordination with the authorized Procurement function and DS stakeholders. Governance, Reporting & Continuous Improvement Ensure procurement activities follow Client policies, delegated authorities, contractual requirements, and documentation standards. Prepare procurement dashboards and reports covering commitments, renewals, savings opportunities, vendor performance, and outstanding actions. Identify gaps in procurement workflows, systems, and controls; recommend and implement approved process improvements. Review supplier invoices against purchase orders, contracts, agreed pricing, delivery evidence, and service milestones to verify accuracy and resolve discrepancies before payment. Coordinate with service owners, Finance, Procurement, and vendors to ensure timely invoice approvals, service entry confirmation, and payment processing. Track invoice status, outstanding commitments, and payment issues; maintain reliable procurement-to-payment records and reporting. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Knowledge of procurement processes, contract renewals, vendor management, and commercial evaluation. Familiarity with IT services, software licensing, and technology asset lifecycles is preferred. Fluent in English Minimum of 3 years’ experience in procurement, sourcing coordination, vendor management, contract renewals, or related business operations. Experience supporting IT procurement is preferred.

3a047dae7b4f9437.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع فن الاتقان الطبي المتخصص عن فني أشعة للانضمام إلى فريقه في الخرمة، مكة المكرمة. يتولى فني الأشعة مسؤولية تجهيز معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية، وإعداد المرضى، وتشغيل الأجهزة لاستخراج الصور الشعاعية وطباعتها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالعمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد وصيانة أجهزة التصوير بالأشعة السينية لضمان جاهزيتها للعمل. تأمين ومراقبة المخزون من مستلزمات التصوير الضرورية مثل الأفلام والأدوية. تطبيق إجراءات الوقاية الشخصية لضمان السلامة المهنية للموظفين والمرضى. تنظيم وتنسيق مواعيد المرضى بكفاءة. مرافقة المرضى إلى غرفة التصوير، وتحديد أجزاء الجسم المراد تصويرها، وتحديد طبيعة الصورة الشعاعية ومواصفات الأشعة المطلوبة بناءً على طلب الطبيب المعالج. تثبيت ألواح من الرصاص لحماية الأجزاء الجسدية التي يجب ألا تتعرض للأشعة. توجيه وضبط أجهزة التصوير، واختيار مدة وشدة التعرض للأشعة، والتقاط الصور الشعاعية. إظهار وتثبيت الصور الشعاعية، وتثبيت المعلومات الأساسية عليها، وتقديمها لطبيب أخصائي الأشعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها، وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الأشعة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والوقاية من الإشعاع. نوع العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مجمع فن الاتقان الطبي المتخصص. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في الخرمة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

3a32906320e9c181.description: About Algihaz Holding Algihaz Holding is a diversified Saudi Arabian company with over 40 years of experience providing integrated solutions across various sectors. The company specializes in conventional energy, renewable energy, communications infrastructure, security services, and entertainment projects. Algihaz Holding achieves its objectives through internal expertise and strategic partnerships with industry experts. Founded in 1975 by Saeed Ali Al-Angari, Algihaz has expanded from a small contracting firm into a multi-million dollar group of companies. The organization is currently expanding into new industries to capitalize on growth opportunities within Saudi Arabia and offshore markets. The Role of HSE Officer Algihaz Holding is seeking an HSE Officer to join its team in Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position designed for professionals with foundational experience in Health, Safety, and Environment roles. The HSE Officer will contribute to maintaining and enhancing safety standards across company operations. Experience Requirements 0-1 year of experience in a relevant HSE role. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position. The role is based in Saudi Arabia. Compensation Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process and is not disclosed in this advertisement.

3a6dfbb60e50a8b7.description: About the Role Premium Food Company is seeking a Production Supervisor to oversee daily plant production operations in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing the production process from raw material issuance to finished product handover, ensuring targets are met efficiently while maintaining quality and food safety standards. Job Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to supervise the entire production cycle, ensuring that daily production targets are achieved on schedule. The Production Supervisor will lead the shift team, monitor product quality and food safety compliance, and implement measures to improve production yield and reduce waste. Key Responsibilities Execute the daily production plan, assign staff to production lines, monitor progress, and resolve operational issues during the shift. Lead the production team, provide training on operating, hygiene, and occupational safety procedures, monitor performance, and coordinate shift handovers. Supervise the preparation, processing, and packaging of beef, poultry, and seafood products according to approved recipes and specifications. Track raw material quantities (issued, used, returned) and reconcile them with finished product output. Analyze yield and waste variances and implement corrective actions. Monitor compliance with Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point (HACCP) requirements and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), including temperature control, segregation of raw materials and finished products, and prevention of cross-contamination. Coordinate with the Quality department regarding nonconformances, oversee the segregation of affected batches, and document actions taken. Record production orders, material movements, output quantities, and waste in the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system, ensuring complete batch records for traceability. Coordinate with the Warehouse team to ensure raw material and packaging supply availability and timely handover of finished products. Collaborate with Maintenance to resolve equipment breakdowns and minimize line downtime. Prepare shift reports on production output, yield, waste, and downtime. Implement improvements to increase line productivity and reduce waste while maintaining product quality. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in a production supervision role. Demonstrated understanding of food safety standards, including HACCP and GMP. Proficiency in using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems for production tracking and reporting. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this Production Supervisor role at Premium Food Company.

3acb507fef8e9981.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مطاعم روتس إيتالي عن مدير مطعم للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق العمليات اليومية للمطعم، بما في ذلك إدارة المرافق والخدمات وعمليات الشراء لضمان تقديم تجربة مميزة للعملاء. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة عملية تخطيط وتقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات والخدمات الأخرى في المطعم. مراقبة استهلاك واستخدام الأطعمة والمشروبات والإمدادات الأخرى، وإدارة عملية اختيار الموردين وإيداع الطلبات. الإشراف على مرافق المطعم والمطبخ، وضمان النظافة والصيانة الدورية. إدارة إنتاج المنتجات الجديدة والخدمات المقدمة وتسليمها بكفاءة. وضع السياسات والإجراءات اللازمة لضمان الالتزام بلوائح الصحة والسلامة العامة، والإشراف على تنفيذها بفعالية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنوات في مجال إدارة المطاعم أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق العمليات التشغيلية. مهارات قوية في إدارة المخزون والموردين. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في حائل، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق مطاعم روتس إيتالي، حيث تتاح الفرصة لتطبيق مهاراتك في بيئة ديناميكية تركز على جودة الخدمة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: حائل الراتب: غير معلن التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

3afefffbce03111d.description: Role Purpose The Finance Manager will oversee the day-to-day finance activities of Moomoo Arabia Capital, ensuring accurate accounting, timely financial reporting, effective financial controls, and compliance with applicable Saudi financial and tax requirements. Reporting directly to the CFO, the role will manage financial closing, budgeting, cash-flow forecasting, tax compliance coordination, and audit readiness. The Finance Manager will work closely with Group Finance and local business functions to establish efficient, scalable finance processes that support the company’s brokerage operations and growth. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Accounting and Reporting Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing process, ensuring accurate and timely financial statements in accordance with IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia and applicable Group accounting policies. Review journal entries, general ledger balances, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, leases, payroll accounting, and supporting schedules. Ensure balance-sheet accounts are reconciled and outstanding items are investigated and resolved. Prepare management reporting packages for the CFO, including financial performance, balance-sheet movements, cash flows, and explanations of significant variances. 2. Brokerage Accounting and Financial Oversight Oversee the accounting treatment and reconciliation of brokerage commissions, platform and service fees, third-party charges, foreign-exchange transactions, and other applicable revenue streams. Perform independent Finance reviews of relevant client-money, settlement, bank, and counterparty reconciliations prepared by Operations. Ensure operational balances reconcile to the general ledger, exceptions are promptly escalated, and company funds remain appropriately distinguished from client funds. Operational custody and settlement responsibilities remain with the designated Operations teams. 3. Budgeting, Forecasting, and Business Support Coordinate the annual budget and periodic forecasts with department heads and Group Finance. Monitor actual performance against approved budgets, investigate variances, and provide actionable commentary to the CFO. Assess operating expenses, headcount costs, vendor commitments, and business initiatives. Support profitability analysis, cost allocation, and financial evaluation of products and projects to inform management decisions. 4. Treasury and Cash-Flow Management Prepare and maintain cash-flow forecasts, monitor corporate liquidity, and identify upcoming funding requirements. Coordinate bank account administration, corporate cash movements, and deposit placements within approved policies and authority limits. Review payment documentation, funding availability, and accounting treatment. Maintain effective controls over payment preparation, approval, and release, ensuring segregation of duties and compliance with the company’s delegation of authority. 5. Regulatory Reporting and Financial Compliance Prepare and review supporting schedules for applicable CMA financial and prudential reporting, including regulatory capital and liquidity monitoring, for CFO review and approval. Maintain a reporting calendar, ensure financial submissions reconcile to accounting records, and promptly escalate potential capital, liquidity, or reporting issues. Coordinate with Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Group Finance on regulatory inquiries and financial information requests. 6. Tax Compliance and Advisory Coordination Manage the preparation and review of applicable VAT, withholding tax, and corporate income tax calculations and supporting records, working with designated tax personnel and external advisers. Oversee tax-account reconciliations, transaction mapping, and e-invoicing controls. Support transfer-pricing documentation and intercompany tax analysis. Provide reconciled financial information for FATCA and CRS reporting in coordination with Compliance and Operations, according to the agreed responsibility framework. 7. Internal Controls and Audit Implement and maintain finance policies, standard operating procedures, approval controls, and documentation requirements. Ensure transactions are properly supported, accurately recorded, and processed within approved authority limits. Coordinate external audits and support internal audits and regulatory inspections. Prepare audit schedules, resolve queries, track findings, and implement corrective actions. Escalate material accounting judgments and control deficiencies to the CFO. 8. Group Coordination, Systems, and Team Development Coordinate with Group Finance on reporting deadlines, accounting policies, intercompany reconciliations, consolidation schedules, and shared-service activities. Identify and reconcile differences between local statutory and Group reporting requirements. Support accounting-system implementation, chart-of-accounts alignment, financial-data integration, and process automation. Supervise assigned finance staff, review their work, establish clear responsibilities, and support the transition of activities from Group support to the local finance team. Qualifications and Experience - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. A professional qualification such as SOCPA, CPA, ACCA, or CA is strongly preferred. - At least 7 years of relevant finance and accounting experience, including 2 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity. - Experience in Saudi financial services, preferably within brokerage, securities, investment services, or another regulated financial institution. - Strong working knowledge of IFRS, Saudi tax compliance, financial controls, and regulatory financial reporting. Experience with CMA-regulated entities is highly desirable. - Proficiency in ERP systems, advanced Excel, and financial reporting tools. Experience with Oracle Fusion, finance automation, and multinational Group reporting is an advantage. - Strong written and spoken English; Arabic proficiency is preferred. Paid Time Off Training & Development Performance Bonus

3a1ce6b1595f24e0.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Project Controls Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves overseeing all project controls functions, ensuring financial accuracy, schedule adherence, and effective cost management throughout the project lifecycle. The Project Controls Manager will serve as a strategic partner to project leadership, providing analytical insights to support informed decision-making and project success. Key Responsibilities Develop, establish, and maintain comprehensive project baseline budgets, schedules, and performance metrics aligned with project scope and organizational standards. Analyze and interpret complex financial data, earned value metrics, and cost/schedule integration reports to identify project issues, trends, and forecasting requirements. 3a6ca47c0e8cecb0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث سوفيتيل جبل عمر عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية والمحاسبية لضمان الدقة والامتثال. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمحاسبين الطموحين لبدء مسيرتهم المهنية في بيئة فندقية مرموقة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على تدقيق المستندات المالية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بالمبادئ المحاسبية وإعداد التقارير المالية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة والقدرة على إدارة الوثائق. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمليات المحاسبية. القدرة على التكيف مع التطورات في مجال المحاسبة. بيئة العمل ستعمل في سوفيتيل جبل عمر، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق مالي ملتزم. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لضمان سير العمليات المحاسبية بسلاسة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى قطاع الضيافة في واحدة من أبرز الوجهات في المملكة العربية السعودية.

3a917fa008c3ebd3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن فني ميكاترونيكس للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات تركيب آلات الميكاترونيكس، وتحديد قطع الغيار، وتحميل البرامج، بالإضافة إلى متابعة إجراءات الصيانة الوقائية وتشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات تركيب آلات الميكاترونيكس، مثل آلات النجارة المبرمجة وآلات المصانع الغذائية، ومتابعة إجراءات تركيبها وفقاً لأدلة التركيب المحددة. تحديد قائمة قطع الغيار الاحتياطية اللازمة لآلات الميكاترونيكس والعمل على تأمينها. تحميل برامج التشغيل والبرامج التطبيقية الخاصة بآلات الميكاترونيكس وإجراء التشغيل التجريبي لضمان الأداء السليم. متابعة إجراءات الصيانة الوقائية وتشخيص الأعطال باستخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس المتخصصة، والعمل على إصلاحها وضبطها. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الميكاترونيكس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وفهم مخططات التركيب الفنية لآلات الميكاترونيكس. معرفة ببرامج التشغيل والتطبيقات الخاصة بآلات الميكاترونيكس. مهارة في استخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس لتشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. الالتزام بتطبيق إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل يقع هذا الدور في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الصيانة والتشغيل في شركة زهران. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه مسبقاً.

Monitor residential market trends, customer preferences, competitor developments, and emerging lifestyle trends. Build and enhance relationships with HCPs/KMEs through structured call and engagement plans. Execute HCP/KME engagement activities and educational programs, including local peer-to-peer meetings. 3a21be5987c68d50.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رمال السواحل للمقاولات والصيانة عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة تطوير خطط التنفيذ، ومراقبة سير العمل لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية، وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، وضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع وكافة التداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع والخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها في الوقت والطريقة المناسبة. التنسيق مع فريق عمل المشروع لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير بناءً على الخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء مراحل المشروع الرئيسية وعملية إغلاق المشروع، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه الرئيسية، وضمان نقل كافة المعارف والخبرات المتعلقة وتوثيق جميع الوثائق والنماذج والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل نجاح المشروع بشكل دوري، ورفع التقارير ذات الصلة لمختلف الأطراف المعنية في المشروع والإدارة العليا. متطلبات الخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة رمال السواحل للمقاولات والصيانة، يرجى التقديم على هذا الدور.

3a796971bb0ff353.description: About Sanabil Studio and Tradepay Sanabil Studio operates as a venture builder, combining industry knowledge, technology, and startup methodologies to develop new businesses. The studio supports ventures from initial concept through launch, providing seed funding and operational support for scaling promising businesses. Tradepay, a venture under Sanabil Studio, is developing a B2B trade and working-capital platform specifically for the FMCG sector in Saudi Arabia. This platform aims to facilitate working capital access for small retailers at the point of purchase, while also supporting manufacturers, brand owners, suppliers, and distributors in expanding sales, improving customer reach, and strengthening their route-to-market. The Role of Partnerships Manager Sanabil Studio is seeking a Partnerships Manager for Tradepay. This is a full-time, commercially driven business development role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focused on building and converting Tradepay’s FMCG partnership pipeline. The role requires a strong understanding of the Saudi FMCG market. The Partnerships Manager will identify suitable partners, initiate engagement, understand their business operations, present Tradepay’s value proposition, and manage opportunities from initial contact through to commercial agreement and implementation handover. The position requires proactive engagement in new business development, relationship building, and persistent pursuit of opportunities to closure. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain a pipeline of FMCG manufacturers, brand owners, suppliers, and distributors. Prioritize potential partners based on merchant reach, traditional-trade exposure, sales volumes, and strategic alignment. Generate new opportunities through existing networks, direct outreach, referrals, industry research, and events. Identify and engage decision-makers across Sales, Commercial, Finance, and senior management levels. Introduce Tradepay and customize the value proposition for each partner’s business model. Analyze partners’ route-to-market strategies, customer base, payment terms, collections processes, credit practices, and commercial challenges. Qualify opportunities and collaborate internally to develop commercially viable partnership propositions. Manage opportunities from initial outreach through meetings, follow-ups, negotiations, and agreement finalization. Maintain deal momentum and proactively address any obstacles that may impede closing. Coordinate with Product, Operations, Risk, Finance, and Legal teams as opportunities progress toward implementation. Maintain accurate records of pipeline stages, next steps, meeting notes, and expected closing dates. Provide regular updates on pipeline coverage, conversion rates, anticipated partner volumes, and commercial insights. Performance Metrics Success in this role will be evaluated based on the following key performance indicators: Qualified pipeline generated. Number of partner meetings conducted. Progression of qualified opportunities. Number of signed partnerships. Expected and activated Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV) from signed partners. Sales-cycle duration. Pipeline-to-close conversion rate.

3ab03ef0aa84d473.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إكسون عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يهدف هذا الدور إلى إعداد وتنفيذ الخطط التسويقية وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية الرقمية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير المحتوى التسويقي. كما يتضمن تحليل السوق والمنافسين لتعزيز العلامة التجارية واستقطاب العملاء وزيادة المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنفيذ الخطط والحملات التسويقية المتكاملة. إدارة حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي وتطوير المحتوى الإعلاني. متابعة أداء الإعلانات الرقمية وتحليل نتائجها لضمان الفعالية. دراسة السوق والمنافسين وتحليل احتياجات العملاء المستهدفين. التنسيق الفعال مع فريق المبيعات لاستقطاب العملاء المحتملين. إعداد التقارير التسويقية الدورية وتقديم مقترحات التطوير والتحسين. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على إعداد وتنفيذ الخطط التسويقية. مهارات في إدارة الحملات الإعلانية الرقمية. القدرة على تطوير المحتوى التسويقي الجذاب. مهارات تحليل السوق والمنافسين. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جازان، ويوفر فرصة للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال التسويق. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

3a82f4ee9353b566.description: Nama Partners is a strategic consulting firm based in Saudi Arabia, working with family groups, holding companies, listed companies, banks, insurance firms, government entities, and industrial establishments. Most of our clients are in the Kingdom or have significant interests there. We take on a limited number of assignments, and the partners who define the scope of work participate in its execution themselves. We are now looking for a graphic designer to be responsible for the visual appearance of everything the company produces, including documents, presentations, and reports. About the Job You will work with the consulting team to transform analytical and strategic material into documents that can be easily read by a board of directors or an executive committee. This means you must be able to read a long spreadsheet, extract the conclusion that matters to the reader, and present it clearly. You will manage the entire visual process from the first file to the final version, dealing directly with the author of the material and understanding what they want the reader to grasp. The work is remote, with the company headquarters in Riyadh, and daily coordination with the team takes place through meetings and shared files. Tasks and Responsibilities Designing presentations and reports submitted to clients, relying on company templates while developing them when necessary. Transforming texts, tables, and numbers received from the team into readable and organized pages, with attention to spacing and information hierarchy. Preparing charts and diagrams that explain figures: comparisons, time developments, organizational structures, and portfolio economics. Maintaining the visual identity in every material issued by the company, from the cover to the footer, and unifying fonts and colors across files. Preparing files for printing and export, reviewing the final version before sending, and keeping an organized copy on the shared system. Working on miscellaneous materials as needed: document templates, slides for short presentations, and internal pages. Required Qualifications Basic knowledge of design software, primarily Adobe InDesign and Illustrator, along with PowerPoint, and general familiarity with other Adobe programs. Initial experience in design from any source: internship, academic project, side work, or a previous assignment. Clear ability to communicate in Arabic, both written and spoken, because most of the material you will work on is in Arabic. Organization in managing files and deadlines, as the work involves multiple assignments simultaneously. Precision in reviewing before delivery, and attention to detail regarding small errors in numbers and headings. Willingness to learn from team feedback and adjust your style accordingly. Additional Preferred Qualifications It is helpful if you have knowledge of corporate document design principles, experience in converting Excel data into charts, knowledge of interface design software, or the ability to read English for references and files coming from abroad. Any previous work in a consulting firm, financial institution, or government entity adds weight to your profile, as does having a portfolio of work to review. What We Offer This is a permanent, full-time position. The work is remote, with the company headquarters in Riyadh, offering flexibility in organizing your day without the need to be present at an office. You will work on real material pertaining to institutional clients established in the Kingdom, and your work will be reviewed against clear professional standards, with direct feedback from the team on every file. Coordination with the author of the material and the partner in charge of the assignment is part of the daily routine, and feedback is concise and direct. How We Work Together The decision in our visual work rests with the person who will stand before the document and explain it. We discuss the file openly and decide which elements deserve to be the most prominent, then we build upon that. Whoever handles the file is responsible for its final appearance and for sending it at the agreed-upon time, and they can object to the layout of a page or a graphic that does not convey a clear message. We do not rely on an external design agency for our daily work, so the full context remains with you: who the reader is, what the proposed decision is, and what the takeaway should be. Anyone who gets used to asking before designing, and to keeping their files organized and properly named, will find this role suitable for their professional start.
